title: A tour of Sitges
text: Had a lovely day, firstly at sea with our skipper Tony, who looked after us so well. We then were given an interesting tour by Claudia of Sitges, learning about its history and then finishing with some lovely wine tasting.
author: Chris_H

title: Sun and Fun in Sitges
text: Sarah the skipper of the boat was very knowledgeable and sociable.  We loved the very informational tour of Sitges! Raphael was wonderful with the wine tasting.
author: Tracy_G

title: Euro Trip
text: I would come back again! Ramon and Oscar were super cool and sailing around Catalonia Island was amazing. The views were great!
author: Juan S

title: Sailing and Wine Tasting
text:
This excursion was conducted in two parts, by two different companies and guides. Our rating of 4/5 is an average of both: 

3 Stars
We planned a morning sail on the Mediterranean as a relaxing end to our holiday. The guide was friendly and chatted as we sailed. We did find it odd that there wasn’t a safety briefing of any sort, not even pointing out the location of life jackets. The boat was under power, not under sail at all, so that was a bit disappointing, too. It wasn’t a weather issue because we saw plenty of other boats using their sails.

5 stars
Winery visit and city walking tour of S
author: Karen_B
